blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Police Commission (Napolcom) introduced new questions in its nationwide Philippine National Police (PNP) entrance and promotional examinations as part of its effort to weed out diploma-mill graduates from the police service. A total of 41,566 civilians and police examinees took the tests from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. on Sunday across designated test centers nationwide.
